response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT projects.fundflux, COUNT(*) as count FROM scanqc INNER JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY projects.fundflux), summary AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_sources FROM counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.count, c.count * 1.0 / s.total_count as fraction, c.count * 1.0 / (s.total_count * 1.0 / s.num_sources) as ratio_to_average FROM counts c CROSS JOIN summary s
